arxiv-2210-02307.title: The Past and Future of Mid-Infrared Studies of AGN
arxiv-2210-02307.creator: Anna Sajina*, Mark Lacy, Alexandra Pope
arxiv-2210-02307.description: Abstract Observational studies of AGN in the mid-infrared regime are crucial to our understanding of AGN and their role in the evolution of galaxies. Mid-IR-based selection of AGN is complementary to more traditional techniques allowing for a more complete census of AGN activity across cosmic time.

arxiv-2303-09246.title: Correlation analysis between OJ 287 radio jet observables AIPS ( Greisen 2003 ) , Python, SAND ( Zhang 2016 ) .
arxiv-2303-09246.creator: Q. Yuan, M. Zhang, X. Liu, P.F. Jiang, G. I. Kokhirova
arxiv-2303-09246.description: Abstract We collected the archival data of blazar OJ 287 from heterogeneous very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) monitoring programs at 2.3 GHz, 8.6 GHz, 15 GHz and 43 GHz. The data reduction and observable extraction of those multi-band multi-epoch observations are batch-processed consistently with our automated pipeline. We present the multivariate correlation analysis on the observables at each band.

arxiv-2407-08408.title: A Two-Stage Machine Learning-Aided Approach for Quench Identification at the European XFEL
arxiv-2407-08408.creator: L. Boukela, A. Eichler, J. Branlard, N.Z. Jomhari
arxiv-2407-08408.description: Abstract This paper introduces a machine learning-aided fault detection and isolation method applied to the case study of quench identification at the European X-Ray Free-Electron Laser. The plant utilizes 800 superconducting radio-frequency cavities in order to accelerate electron bunches to high energies of up to 17.5 GeV 17.5\text{\,}\mathrm{G}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V} .

arxiv-2410-03504.title: Uncertainty-Aware Environment Simulation of Medical Devices Digital Twins
arxiv-2410-03504.creator: Hassan Sartaj, Shaukat Ali, Julie Marie Gjøby
arxiv-2410-03504.description: Abstract Smart medical devices are an integral component of the healthcare Internet of Things (IoT), providing patients with various healthcare services through an IoT-based application. Ensuring the dependability of such applications through system and integration-level testing mandates the physical integration of numerous medical devices, which is costly and impractical.

arxiv-2509-05800.title: Transformer-based Topology Optimization Journal: Structural and Multidisciplinary Optimization
arxiv-2509-05800.creator: Aaron Lutheran, Srijan Das, Alireza Tabarraei
arxiv-2509-05800.description: Abstract Topology optimization enables the design of highly efficient and complex structures, but conventional iterative methods, such as SIMP-based approaches, often suffer from high computational costs and sensitivity to initial conditions. Although machine learning methods have recently shown promise for accelerating topology generation, existing models either remain iterative or struggle to match ground-truth performance.

arxiv-2510-06490.title: A Precise Performance Analysis of the Randomized Singular Value Decomposition
arxiv-2510-06490.creator: Danil Akhtiamov ∗, Reza Ghane ∗, Babak Hassibi
arxiv-2510-06490.description: Abstract The Randomized Singular Value Decomposition (RSVD) is a widely used algorithm for efficiently computing low-rank approximations of large matrices, without the need to construct a full-blown SVD. Of interest, of course, is the approximation error of RSVD compared to the optimal low-rank approximation error obtained from the SVD.

pmc-10909102.title: E74-like Factor 5 Promoter Methylation in Circulating Tumor DNA as a Potential Prognostic Marker in Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-10909102.creator: Mahdieh Salimi, Shima Rastegarpouyani
pmc-10909102.description: Background:Epigenetic alternations, such as DNA methylation, play a crucial role in breast tumor initiation and progression. The identification of noninvasive prognostic biomarkers has great importance in cancer management. Methylated cell-free DNA (cfDNA), circulating in the blood as a convenient tumor-associated DNA marker, can be used as a minimally invasive cancer biomarker.

pmc-11637374.title: Advancing food security: Rice yield estimation framework using time-series satellite data & machine learning
pmc-11637374.creator: Varun Tiwari, Kelly Thorp, Mirela G Tulbure, Joshua Gray, Mohammad Kamruzzaman, Timothy J Krupnik, A Sankarasubramanian, Marcelo Ardon, Salim Heddam, Salim Heddam, Salim Heddam, Salim Heddam
pmc-11637374.description: Timely and accurately estimating rice yields is crucial for supporting food security management, agricultural policy development, and climate change adaptation in rice-producing countries such as Bangladesh. To address this need, this study introduced a workflow to enable timely and precise rice yield estimation at a sub-district scale (1,000-meter spatial resolution).

pmc-13619545.title: An integrated lifestyle intervention for mitigation of adverse effects associated with androgen deprivation therapy for prostate cancer (STAMINA): a multicentre, randomised trial
pmc-13619545.creator: Liam Bourke, Derek J Rosario, Sophie Reale, Said Ibeggazene, Aidan Innes, Alison Scope, Grace Price, Steph Taylor, Liz Steed, Eileen Sutton, Jamie Stokes, Jenny Hewison, Dylan Morrissey, Patrick Doherty, Janet Brown, David Meads, John L O’Dwyer, Davina Deniszczyc, Diana M Greenfield, Malcolm Mason,
pmc-13619545.description: SummaryBackgroundAndrogen deprivation therapy (ADT) for prostate cancer causes substantial adverse effects. Despite consistent national and international guideline recommendations, supervised exercise is rarely integrated into care. We aimed to determine whether the STAMINA lifestyle intervention, embedded into cancer care, would improve cancer-specific quality of life and fatigue versus behaviourally Optimised Usual Care in men with prostate cancer in England.
